case_metadata.title: Case 3: A521 Huntley Brook HGV Lane Encroachment
case_metadata.subtitle: KX71 HGV (DAF XF 480 Articulated HGV) vs LV20 RTY (Vauxhall Astra — Wet Bend)

agentic_video_scrub_steps.summary: Pass 1 (Corridor & Causal Relevance Filter): Analysed A521 Huntley Brook S-bend corridor. Stripped 4 non-causal background objects (3 vehicles parked inside a commercial lay-by and 1 pedestrian shelter) while preserving the encroaching DAF XF articulated HGV (KX71 HGV), the oncoming Vauxhall Astra (LV20 RTY), and the Diagram 1004.1 centre hazard line.

Pass 2 (Swept-Path & Pneumatic Brake Lag Analysis t=0.25s..1.50s): Measured KX71 HGV entering the wet bend at 38.5 mph (mu=0.50), with trailer offside overhang encroaching 1.15m across the centre hazard line and 0.45s pneumatic brake actuator lag.

Pass 3 (DVSA Causal vs Non-Causal Audit): Flagged KX71 HGV's second-axle air brake actuator seepage [1.2.2] as CAUSAL to its extended wet-bend braking distance, while flagging LV20 RTY's parking brake advisory [1.4.2] and historical 2024 rear stop-lamp failure as NOT CAUSAL because LV20 RTY was travelling in its own lane using its hydraulic footbrake.

physics_audit_log:
ANTIGRAVITY SANDBOX KINEMATIC VERIFICATION (`antigravity-preview-09-2026` | `gemini-4-argon`):
1. ARTICULATED HGV WET-BEND BRAKING & SWEPT PATH ENCROACHMENT (μ = 0.50 WET TARMAC):
   - KX71 HGV (38,000 kg gross combination weight) entered the A521 Huntley Brook bend at 38.5 mph (17.21 m/s).
   - Incorporating 0.45s pneumatic air-brake build-up lag (exacerbated by DVSA second-axle actuator seepage 1.2.2) plus 0.67s driver reaction time, HGV stopping distance on wet asphalt (μ_hgv = 0.42) was 55.2m, sweeping the offside trailer corner 1.15m across the Diagram 1004.1 centre hazard line.
   - LV20 RTY (Vauxhall Astra) approached in the opposing lane at 34.0 mph (30 mph limit) and delayed evasive nearside steering by 0.4s, resulting in an 80% Defendant (KX71 HGV) / 20% Claimant (LV20 RTY) split under Laurie v Raglan Building Co Ltd [1942] and Baker v Willoughby [1970].

report.incident_summary: At 16:05 BST during steady rain on the A521 Huntley Brook S-bend corridor (30 mph urban transition zone), a 2021 White DAF XF 480 6x2 Articulated HGV (KX71 HGV, Vehicle A) descended Westbound at 38.5 mph, encroaching 1.15m across the central Diagram 1004.1 hazard warning line into the Eastbound lane due to excessive wet-bend entry speed and pneumatic air-brake actuator lag (DVSA advisory 1.2.2). An oncoming 2020 Blue Vauxhall Astra (LV20 RTY, Vehicle B) travelling Eastbound at 34.0 mph braked at t=0.60s but failed to steer toward the available 1.2m nearside tarmac margin before glancing offside-to-offside impact occurred at (x=-0.8m, z=0.5m) at t=1.35s.

report.stopping_distance_analysis: Under UK Highway Code Rule 126 and Rule 221, heavy goods vehicles require substantially longer wet stopping distances due to pneumatic brake lag and lower tyre-road friction on wet asphalt (mu_hgv = 0.42). At KX71 HGV's entry speed of 38.5 mph (17.21 m/s) with a 0.45s air-brake actuator build-up delay (DVSA advisory 1.2.2), total stopping distance reached 55.2m (19.3m reaction+lag + 35.9m braking), causing lateral trailer off-tracking of 1.15m into the opposing lane. LV20 RTY approached at 34.0 mph in a 30 mph zone (wet stopping distance 33.7m vs 27.4m at 30 mph).

forensic_events.description: KX71 HGV enters wet A521 Huntley Brook S-bend at 38.5 mph in a 30 mph zone.
KX71 HGV applies air brakes; second-axle actuator seepage (DVSA 1.2.2) adds 0.45s pneumatic lag as trailer sweeps 1.15m over Diagram 1004.1 centre line.
LV20 RTY brakes from 34.0 mph in Eastbound lane but fails to steer toward the 1.2m nearside tarmac margin.
Offside-to-offside encroachment impact at (x=-0.8m, z=0.5m) inside LV20 RTY's Eastbound lane.

primary_highway_code_rules_breached: Highway Code Rules 124, 126 & 221: KX71 HGV exceeded the 30 mph limit (38.5 mph) on a wet bend and encroached 1.15m across the Diagram 1004.1 centre hazard line.
Highway Code Rule 124 & Rule 125: LV20 RTY approached the wet bend at 34.0 mph in a 30 mph limit and delayed nearside evasive steering.

case_law_citations.legal_principle: Apportionment weighs both the heightened causative potency of a heavy vehicle's kinetic energy and the observation/evasive duties of both drivers.
case_law_citations.application_to_crash: Fixes 80% primary liability on the 38-tonne DAF HGV (KX71 HGV) for crossing the centre line, with 20% contributory negligence on LV20 RTY for slight excess speed (34 mph in a 30 zone).
case_law_citations.policy_section_ref: Policy #UK-8841 Section 6 Clause 6.3 (80% / 20% HGV Corridor Encroachment Band)

case_law_citations.legal_principle: Forensic time-distance reconstruction determines whether excess speed deprived a driver of avoidance capability.
case_law_citations.application_to_crash: Proves that at a compliant 30 mph on wet tarmac, LV20 RTY would have stopped 6.3m earlier and cleared the trailer swept path.

report.legal_reasoning_chain:
1. PRIMARY BREACH (80% DEFENDANT — KX71 HGV): KX71 HGV entered a wet 30 mph bend at 38.5 mph, and its CAUSAL second-axle air brake actuator seepage (DVSA 1.2.2) contributed to a 1.15m encroachment across the Diagram 1004.1 centre line.
2. CONTRIBUTORY NEGLIGENCE & NON-CAUSAL DVSA EXCLUSION (20% CLAIMANT — LV20 RTY): LV20 RTY bears 20% contributory fault for travelling at 34.0 mph in a 30 mph zone and failing to steer left into the available nearside margin. LV20 RTY's DVSA parking brake advisory (`1.4.2`) and rectified 2024 rear stop-lamp failure are explicitly flagged NOT CAUSAL.
